summary: community.hrobot 2.0.0 no longer supports Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 or ansible-core 2.11 to 2.13. It may still work but could break without notice.

answer_card.title: community.hrobot drops old Ansible versions
answer_card.answer_md: community.hrobot 2.0.0 drops support for Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 and ansible-core 2.11 to 2.13. It may still work, but breakage on those versions isn't treated as a bug.
